TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with the Annual Ijtema being organized by Shahi Idgah Management Committee from 11.10.2025 to 13.10.2025 at Idgah Road, Sadar Bazar, Delhi.

📍 Heavy traffic likely from 10:00 PM on 10.10.2025 till 10:00 PM on 13.10.2025.
📍 Traffic Diversions (on need basis): Azad Market Chowk, Barfkhanna Chowk, R/A Panchkuyan, Ram Kumar Marg, R/A Jhandewalan, Y-Point Faiz Road, R/A Idgah.
📍 Traffic Restrictions: Entry on Idgah Road (R/A Idgah ↔ Ram Kumar Marg) closed on both carriageways. Congestion expected on Rani Jhansi Road till R/A Jhandewalan.
📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

7.4 Magnitude Earthquake Off Davao Oriental Kills Seven in Philippines 🚨

A magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck off the coast of Davao Oriental in the southern Philippines on October 10, 2025, at 9:43 a.m. local time, shaking Mindanao and parts of Visayas while prompting evacuations due to a brief tsunami warning. The quake caused seven deaths from structural collapses near the epicenter and damaged infrastructure, with over 170 aftershocks, including a 6.9 magnitude event, following as authorities urged caution. PHIVOLCS canceled the tsunami advisory after confirming no significant waves, highlighting the region's vulnerability on the Pacific Ring of Fire.
